## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
(Infrastructure task — DD ownership implicit via task-3 dd-1/dd-2 and task-7 dd-6 consumers.)

Create plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/_errors.py defining DirectionMismatchError, UnknownActionError, StatusMappingError (each subclasses Exception, accepts __init__(message)). Module ships green — no consumers yet.

## Test Approach (Given/When/Then)
Given the new _errors module; When test_errors.py imports the three classes and instantiates each; Then each is subclass of Exception and str() returns the message.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/_errors.py tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_errors.py
- [ ] Three exceptions importable + Exception subclasses
  Verify: python3 -c "from plugins.dso.scripts.dso_reconciler._errors import DirectionMismatchError, UnknownActionError, StatusMappingError"
- [ ] str(exc) preserves message
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_errors.py

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/_errors.py — Create
- tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_errors.py — Create

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On sonnet exhaustion: escalate to opus; on opus exhaustion: escalate to user.
